metadata.case_name: AMJAD v. WONG YUI CHEONG T/A CHEONG KEE TRANSPORTATION CO

plaintiff.occupation_before: delivery worker / light goods vehicle driver and loader

source: I am satisfied that Mr Amjad sustained injury to his left shoulder and lower back as a result of the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

injuries.description: injury to his lower back / lumbar spine (including sacralization at L5 and disc bulging L2-L5)
source: I am satisfied that Mr Amjad sustained injury to his left shoulder and lower back as a result of the accident.
According to the MRI of the lumbar spine taken on 15 July 2006, there was sacralization at L5 level, with disc bulging from L2 to L5 levels.
He complained of sternal pain and was found to have tenderness over the lower abdomen and bruising and tenderness over the lower lumbar spine.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: occasional pain at the base of the spine radiating to right thigh, aggravated by long walking, sitting, heavy lifting, cold weather, or changing position in sleep
occasional pain in left shoulder joint

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He used to play cricket but could not enjoy this sport now.
He would not be able to resume the pre-accident work which involved heavy and/or constant lifting in the course of loading and unloading in the transportation business.
